sv.title: Mannen med dödslistan sökte morduppdrag
sv.summary: 30-åringen med en dödslista på sina skolkamrater ville bli kontraktsmördare. Han plockade upp en pistol i Göteborg och väntade vid en adress. Men offret kom aldrig, 30-åringen tröttnade, tog tåget hem och sköt mot en gammal klasskamrat.

en.title: Man with death list sought murder contract
en.summary: The 30-year-old with a death list of his schoolmates wanted to become a contract killer. He picked up a pistol in Göteborg and waited outside an address. But the victim never came, the 30-year-old gave up, took the train home and shot at an old classmate.
